items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: After that used Cab Calloway and Ethel Waters and Bill Robinson downtown and didn't get Buck and Bubbles, ain't that something, they didn't go downtown.

ctx.x: You would think that in future years they would have brought back Buck and Bubbles.
Buck and Bubbles were brought back way later downtown. They used the new Cotton Club so they got Buck and Bubbles
later. After that used Cab Calloway and Ethel Waters and Bill Robinson downtown and didn't get Buck and Bubbles, ain't that something, they didn't go downtown.
